scope: European museum expansion: no US museum searches and no already-explored SMK

sources.name: Rijksmuseum
sources.data_access: Official public Linked Art Search API, no API key
sources.image_access: Official micr.io IIIF 3-hop visual item to digital object
sources.image_license: Individual object PD or CC0, not assumed for every image
sources.notes: Paintings 1850-1960, landscapes; many old masters unsuitable dark

sources.name: Nationalmuseum Sweden
sources.data_access: Official Museum-linked Wikimedia Commons institutional category
sources.image_access: Wikimedia Commons official file thumbnail CDN
sources.image_license: PD on selected Commons museum donated files, per-file rights confirmation
sources.notes: Never count author-search Commons pool again as new museum source unless dedup by source file ID, title/artist and image sha

sources.name: Belvedere Museum
sources.data_access: Public official collection web Open Content pages
sources.image_access: Official collection item with CC0 badge / IIIF if available
sources.image_license: CC0 only for individual post-copyright works, not blanket for all
sources.notes: Austrian modern landscape and vivid floral paintings; require official item evidence before images

sources.name: Finnish National Gallery (Ateneum, Sinebrychoff, Kiasma)
sources.data_access: Official collection portal/data packages; API key may be required for machine access
sources.image_access: More than 36,000 images officially declared CC0; per-image Copyright Free badge
sources.image_license: CC0 for Copyright Free items, others remain In Copyright
sources.notes: Prioritize Ateneum outdoor scenes and color; do not assume all 36,000 are modern or painting

sources.name: Birmingham Museums Trust / Birmingham Museum & Art Gallery
sources.data_access: Official searchable images and sound media portal
sources.image_access: Institution offers CC0 downloads for out-of-copyright works
sources.image_license: CC0 for individual public-domain items; verify record on media portal
sources.notes: Strong regional landscape/post-Impressionist potential; provenance and image rights must be checked

sources.name: Museum of New Zealand Te Papa Tongarewa
sources.data_access: Official Collections API 1.5.5, GET full-text search no token per documented quick start; advanced POST requires an API key
sources.image_access: ImageObject media with per-file rights, some restricted
sources.image_license: Metadata CC BY 4.0, image per-object PDM/CC0/CC BY/other; no blanket images
sources.notes: New Zealand regional landscapes; modern painting subjects, respect Māori and cultural permissions

sources.name: Städel Museum
sources.data_access: Official OAI-PMH documentation and export; may require free access activation
sources.image_license: CC BY-SA 4.0; credit and share-alike requirements, may affect delivery
sources.notes: If sign-in/account needed STOP and do not bypass

sources.name: Paris Musées / Petit Palais / Musée d'Art Moderne de Paris
sources.data_access: Official JSON Collections API, but requires account and authentication token; public portal accessible
sources.image_access: Only individually public-domain images tagged unrestricted / CC0
sources.image_license: Public-domain CC0 subset only, modern works often protected
sources.notes: 14 Paris civic museums; do not confuse Musée d'Orsay/Orangerie with Paris Musées civic network

sources.name: Nasjonalmuseet / National Museum
sources.data_access: Collection metadata via DigitaltMuseum API; API key may be required
sources.image_license: Mixed, check PDM/CC0 per work and per culture-related restrictions
sources.notes: Nordic coastal landscapes but many mixed rights

sources.name: National Gallery London
sources.image_license: CC BY-NC-ND prohibited for commercial/derivative integration without permissions

sources.name: National Gallery of Victoria
sources.image_access: Public-domain image downloads advertised only for non-commercial usage
sources.image_license: Noncommercial limitation incompatible with assumed monetized Art Drift use
